parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) accurately and completely realize the parent high-level goal (HLG) of providing citizens with a transparent and accessible reporting system. The LLGs cover all essential aspects of the HLG, including displaying reports on an interactive map, in a summary table, applying filters, and sorting options. Each child LLG has documentary support, correct scope, and no redundancy.

The 'Display public reports on interactive map with geolocation' (llg_001) corresponds to the HLG's requirement for citizens to view reports on an interactive map. The 'Display public reports in summary table with metadata' (llg_002) aligns with the need for a summary table listing reports with metadata. The 'Apply filters to reports by category, status, or date' (llg_003) and 'Sort reports by category, status, or date' (llg_004) cover the filtering and sorting aspects of the HLG.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs were found. All essential capabilities are present and distinctly documented. The decomposition is complete, supported, and non-redundant.
